title: Terrain, Autotile & Connectivity Grammar
start_authority: Owner Continue freshly verified exact AIOC/application heads, re-read completed MAI-01..03 evidence and resolved the bounded terrain/autotile/connectivity grammar before implementation.
objective: Implement deterministic provider-neutral terrain/autotile/connectivity grammar over completed MAI-02 schema and MAI-03 projection data without creating World topology, gameplay traversability, runtime geometry ownership, importer/resolver/workbench behavior or durable persistence changes.

source_semantics.rule: Normalize only explicitly represented source semantics; preserve unsupported/vendor-specific metadata and never infer missing connectivity.

resolved_contract.terrain_descriptor: Stable terrain IDs and optional semantic owner references describe visual terrain categories independently from selected tile art.

connection_grammar.gridless_rule: Gridless projection has no canonical adjacency ports and must return explicit unsupported-autotile findings.
connection_grammar.channel_rule: Two visual ports connect only when explicit connection channels and compatibility sets agree; adjacency observation alone never creates compatibility.

resolved_contract.autotile_selection: Build a deterministic normalized neighbor signature from explicit local neighbor terrain/connectivity observations, then select among eligible visual variants by priority followed by stable asset/tile ID. If no permitted compatible asset exists, return an explicit MAI-01 incomplete-pack outcome rather than inventing art.
resolved_contract.projection_reuse: Consume MAI-03 grid/projection descriptors only to interpret local visual neighbor orientation; never promote those coordinates or matches into World topology or gameplay truth.

acceptance_profile.provider_neutral: No Tiled Wang set, LDtk terrain rule, Foundry scene construct, or other vendor/editor model becomes canonical.
acceptance_profile.deterministic_matching: Explicit connection-port/channel grammar yields stable neighbor signatures and stable variant selection independent of platform.
acceptance_profile.incomplete_pack: No-match, unavailable, incompatible or unpermitted visual assets remain explicit and reuse MAI-01 outcomes/manual override rules.
acceptance_profile.owner_boundaries: Terrain/autotile/connectivity is visual composition metadata only; it cannot create World adjacency/routes, gameplay traversability, movement cost, collision, combat state, visibility state or owner mutation.
acceptance_profile.predecessor_boundaries: Preserve MAI-01 license/incomplete-pack rules, MAI-02 provenance/unsupported-metadata/schema truth and MAI-03 projection/scale presentation boundaries.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused MAI-04 verifier and client regression plus MAI-03 predecessor, MAI-02 schema, MAI-01 survey and MIB-11 World-owner regressions, then exact-head Repository Health and governed self-hosted Linux/Windows deterministic comparison before merge.

nonauthorization: World topology/navigation/traversability inferred from visual connectivity
migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: Implement only the bounded MAI-04 terrain/autotile/connectivity grammar and focused evidence on integration/mai-04-terrain-autotile-connectivity-grammar; validate exact head, merge only after required gates pass, then close MAI-04 completed_verified and select MAI-05 without starting it.
